scenario_description: QuickBuy’s COO, Luisa Rodriguez, discovers a significant ethical issue, their new AI inventory management system is biased, leading to disparities in stock levels between affluent and diverse neighborhoods. This affects company reputation and raises concerns about perpetuating socioeconomic inequalities. Luisa now faces the challenge of recalibrating the AI to prevent biased decision making and creating a review process for ongoing ethical oversight. Her actions will set a precedent for how QuickBuy integrates values of fairness and equity in their AI applications, demonstrating to stakeholders the importance of responsible AI governance.
